steps.title: Seed HEK293T cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Rinse a 40 % confluent HEK293T flask with 10 mL PBS, aspirate, add 5 mL TrypLE Express and incubate 3–5 min, neutralize with 10 mL AAV Transfection Media, transfer to a 50 mL conical tube, count cells, plate 20 ×10⁶ cells in a T225 flask with 45 mL AAV Transfection Media, and incubate 8–12 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare and deliver transfection mix
steps.instruction: Warm plain Opti‑MEM to 20–25 °C. For each T225 flask add in order: 2 mL Opti‑MEM, 6 µg transfer plasmid, 22 µg pDGM6, RevIT AAV enhancer to a final 1 µL/mL, and 112 µL PEI (1 mg/mL). Invert gently after each addition, incubate 15 min at 20–25 °C, add 2 mL of the mix dropwise to the flask, rock side‑to‑side for even distribution, and incubate 48–72 h at 37 °C. No media change is required unless cytotoxicity is observed.

steps.title: Purify AAV from producer cells
steps.instruction: If using frozen cell pellets, thaw at 20–25 °C and vortex thoroughly. Add 2 mL AAV Extraction Solution A, vortex 15 s, incubate 5 min at 20–25 °C, vortex again, centrifuge 8,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C (repeat optional), transfer supernatant, add Extraction Solution B at 1/10 volume (solution may turn pink), then proceed immediately or store at –80 °C (thaw at 37 °C before use).

steps.title: Treat AAV with nuclease and precipitate
steps.instruction: Add Cryonase cold‑active nuclease at 1/100 volume, incubate 37 °C for 1 h. Add Precipitator A at 1/10 volume, vortex 10 s, incubate 37 °C for 30 min, vortex again. Add Precipitator B at 1/20 volume, vortex 10 s, centrifuge 5,000–9,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, filter supernatant through a 0.45 µm Millex‑HV filter, transfer to an Amicon Ultra‑4 (100 kDa) device, centrifuge 2,000 × g for 5 min at 15 °C, confirm volume <0.4 mL, discard flow‑through, add 1 mL Suspension Buffer, mix, centrifuge 2,000 × g for 5 min at 15 °C, repeat buffer exchange until a total of 5 mL Suspension Buffer has passed, discard final flow‑through, mix concentrate, transfer to a clean tube. Maintain sterility; store concentrate at –80 °C if needed.

steps.title: Create AAV serial dilutions for dPCR
steps.instruction: Prepare 1:1 K dilution by mixing 198 µL nuclease‑free water with 2 µL of the 1:10 diluted QE‑treated AAV. Prepare 1:10 K dilution by mixing 18 µL water with 2 µL of the 1:1 K dilution. Prepare 1:100 K dilution by mixing 18 µL water with 2 µL of the 1:10 K dilution. Vortex each dilution thoroughly and spin down before use.

steps.title: Prepare dPCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine 3.0 µL dPCR Master Mix (QIAGEN), 0.3 µL ITR Primer/Probe Mix (IDT), 10.2 µL DNase/RNase‑free water, and 1.5 µL diluted AAV sample (or water for NTC). Scale volumes according to the total number of reactions (include duplicates of 1:100 K and 1:1 M dilutions per sample, 2 NTCs, and 1–2 extra reactions). Keep all components on ice and protected from light.

steps.title: Assemble final dPCR reactions
steps.instruction: To each sterile PCR tube add 13.5 µL prepared master mix and 1.5 µL diluted AAV or water (for NTC), mix gently, then load 15 µL of each mixture into the designated wells of a QIAcuity 8.5k 24‑well Nanoplate according to the provided layout. Avoid bubbles, seal the plate, and load it into the QIAcuity instrument.

steps.title: Run dPCR cycling and imaging
steps.instruction: Run the following program: 95 °C 2 min initial activation, then 40 cycles of 95 °C 15 s denaturation followed by 60 °C 30 s annealing/extension. Set imaging parameters to channel exposure 500 ms and gain 6. Ensure partitions are evenly distributed and the plate is properly seated before starting the run.

steps.title: Prepare HSPCs and reagents for electroporation
steps.instruction: Thaw CD34⁺ HSPCs and plate at 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL in HSPC Culture Media 48–72 h before editing. Reconstitute desiccated gRNA in 30 µL nuclease‑free water (≈1.5 nmol), keep concentration ≤4 µg/µL, and use 3.2 µg gRNA per condition. Use 6 µg Cas9 protein per condition (0.6 µL if stock is 10 µg/µL). Prepare 20 µL P3 Electroporation Buffer (with Lonza supplement) per condition. Optional: add AZD7648 HDR enhancer to a final 0.5 µM (add 1.4 µL of 2 mM stock per 5 mL media). Calculate AAV amount as 5 × 10³ viral genomes per cell; multiply by the number of cells in the well. For 5 × 10⁴–4 × 10⁶ cells the Cas9 and gRNA amounts stay constant; scale P3 buffer, Cas9, and gRNA 5‑fold for up to 20 M cells per cuvette.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA with QuickExtract
steps.instruction: Harvest ≥2–5 × 10⁴ edited HSPCs 2–3 days post‑editing, spin 300 × g for 5 min, aspirate media, thaw if frozen, add QuickExtract buffer (10 µL for a non‑visible pellet, 20 µL for a visible pellet, ≥50 µL for dense pellets), transfer to mini‑PCR tubes, and run: 65 °C 6 min, 100 °C 10 min, then hold at 12 °C.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA with column kit
steps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in Buffer ATL, add Proteinase K and incubate at 56 °C until lysed, add Buffer AL and incubate 56 °C for 10 min, add 96‑100 % ethanol and mix, load onto QIAGEN DNeasy spin column, centrifuge, wash with Buffers AW1 and AW2, and elute DNA in 200 µL Buffer AE. Perform all centrifugations at 20–25 °C.

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 % agarose gel by mixing 150 mL 1× TAE, 1.5 g agarose, and 8 µL fluorescent dye (e.g., Midori Green). Load up to 50 µL PCR product (or Phusion Green mix) per well together with 10–25 µL DNA ladder, run at 150 V for 30 min (check progress at 15 min), visualize, and cut the band of interest with a clean blade. Gel slices may be stored at 4 °C for up to 24 h.

steps.title: Extract DNA from gel slice
steps.instruction: Weigh the gel slice, add 3 × its volume of Buffer QG (6 × if gel >2 %), incubate 50 °C for 10 min vortexing every 2–3 min, confirm yellow color, add an equal volume of isopropanol, mix, load onto a QIAquick MinElute column, centrifuge 17,900 × g for 1 min, wash with Buffer QG then Buffer PE, dry spin at 17,900 × g for 1 min, elute with 10 µL Buffer EB or water (incubate 20–25 °C 1 min, spin 17,900 × g 1 min). Optional: repeat elution, reuse flow‑through, or run an aliquot on a gel to confirm cleanup.

steps.title: Perform flow cytometry on edited cells
steps.instruction: Spin ≥5 × 10⁴ cells at 300 × g for 5 min, aspirate media, resuspend pellet in 100 µL Flow Cytometry Buffer (PBS + 5 % FBS + 2 mM EDTA), stain with fluorescent antibodies at manufacturer‑recommended concentrations, incubate 4 °C for 30 min in the dark, wash with 1 mL Buffer, spin 300 × g for 5 min, aspirate, resuspend in 100 µL Buffer, and add 1 µL GhostRed viability dye.

steps.title: Phase 1 erythroid differentiation (Days 0‑6)
steps.instruction: Thaw, expand, and edit HSPCs as described. On Day 0 seed cells at 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL in freshly prepared Phase 1 Erythroid Differentiation Media and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. On Day 4 count cells and viability, then dilute back to 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL with Phase 1 media, transfer to larger flasks or plates, and continue incubation without media change until Day 7.

steps.title: Phase 2 erythroid differentiation (Days 7‑10)
steps.instruction: On Day 7 count cells, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min, aspirate Phase 1 media, resuspend pellet at 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL in Phase 2 Erythroid Differentiation Media, and incubate until Day 11 without media change. Monitor cell morphology regularly.

steps.title: Phase 3 erythroid maturation (Days 11‑14)
steps.instruction: On Day 11 count cells, adjust density to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in Phase 3 Erythroid Differentiation Media, and incubate until Day 14 without media change.

steps.title: Harvest and count differentiated erythroid cells
steps.instruction: On Day 14 collect the culture, count total cells, and note the appearance of a distinct red pellet as an indicator of successful erythroid differentiation.

steps.title: Assess differentiation by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Stain cells with antibodies against CD34, CD45, CD71, CD235a (GPA), and CD36 (surface markers) at 1:50 dilution (2 µL antibody per 100 µL cell suspension) and DRAQ5 at 1:200–1:1,000. Analyze to confirm CD34⁻/CD45⁻/GPA⁺/CD71⁺ phenotype.

steps.title: Prepare samples for HPLC analysis
steps.instruction: Collect at least 5 × 10⁵ Day 14 erythroid cells, pellet at 300 × g for 5 min, aspirate supernatant, and store the pellet at –80 °C until high‑performance liquid chromatography.

steps.title: Prepare samples for RNA‑Seq
steps.instruction: Collect at least 5 × 10⁵ Day 14 erythroid cells. Process immediately with a commercial RNA‑extraction kit or preserve in TRIzol (use 1 mL TRIzol per 5–10 × 10⁶ cells; for ~5 × 10⁵ cells use 100 µL TRIzol). Store appropriately for downstream bulk RNA‑sequencing.

steps.title: Cresyl blue staining of erythroid cells
steps.instruction: Collect 1–2 × 10⁵ Day 14 erythroid cells, resuspend in 1 % cresyl blue solution in PBS, incubate at 20–25 °C for 15–30 min, prepare cytospin slides, and image under bright‑field microscopy to assess enucleation and reticulocyte morphology.
